title: Destructuring Structs
goal: Unpack structs and tuples into individual variables using patterns.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Afternoon: Pattern Matching

sections.text: You can unpack structs and tuples directly in a `match` or `let` statement.

sections.code:
let p = Point { x: 10, y: 20 };
let Point { x, y } = p;
sections.caption: Field names become local variables automatically.

sections.text: When you only care about specific fields, use `..` to ignore the remaining ones.

sections.caption: `..` ignores all unlisted struct fields.

sections.text: Nested patterns unpack inner structures in one step. You can destructure tuples inside structs without temporary variables.

explanation: Unpack structs and tuples into individual variables using patterns.
